payload.detail: CLOSED-PENDING-RECONCILE 2026-09-09 by Ward Lead. The asymmetry PR #2571 fixed now has the proof this row was held open for. tests/ward-pull-judgement-gate.test.ts (commit c6790c8eb3) exercises the COORDINATOR PULL path with a pair whose only failing gate is a judgement gate, which is exactly what the reducer's own comment above the eligibilityRefusal call demanded and what did not exist. Construction: WF-003 moved from Adult to Older adult flips exactly one gate, because the movement path of eligibility() emits ten gates, cohort is the only one keyed to Movement.cohort, and the age gate reads referral.ageBand on the referral path alone. WF-003 already sits at accepted_awaiting_bed at rph-adult-secure and carries specialling false, so the specialling refusal directly above the gate cannot fire and steal the red. Three cases: a POSITIVE CONTROL asserting the identical pull succeeds when cohort matches (without it the refusal could be any of the six checks that run before the gate); the refusal asserted as 'failed gate cohort:' rather than a bare substring, and explicitly NOT any of the four neighbouring refusal messages; and the override path, since cohort sits inside SUITABILITY_GATES. PROVED BY THREE MUTATIONS, each killed by its intended assertion and each read for WHICH message came back, not just the colour: (1) pull-path eligibilityRefusal replaced with null - only the refusal case reddened, at the rejection count, and the other two correctly stayed green because both expect a successful pull; (2) the refusal message hardcoded to name gate 'security' - killed by the failed-gate assertion, which read back 'failed gate security: Adult unit does not match an older adult movement'; (3) the upstream allocatable_bed check forced to always fire - all three reddened and the positive control reported 'refused before cohort was even reached: no allocatable bed remains at RPH Adult Secure', proving the control is discriminating rather than decorative. Reducer restored byte-identically after each (cmp, not a hash - hash-object normalises line endings). 151 tests pass across ward-flow-reducer, ward-referral-reducer, ward-eligibility and this file. NOTHING IN src/ WAS CHANGED - this row was never a missing fix, only a missing proof.
